name: Satan
title: The Accuser and God's Adversary
summary: Satan is the name of the fallen adversary who opposes God and humanity. He appears as an accuser against Job, tempts Jesus in the wilderness, and is referred to as the devil, the ancient serpent. Through Christ's victory on the cross, his power has been broken, and his final defeat has been proclaimed.

keyEvents.title: Tempting Jesus in the Wilderness
keyEvents.description: Satan tempted Jesus in the wilderness after His forty days of fasting, but was rebuffed with God's word.

keyEvents.title: Accusing Job
keyEvents.description: Satan appeared among the sons of God and was permitted to test the righteous Job.
